description:
## Status

Refuted. Do not port or land the parked per-answer derivation experiment.

The experiment measured a 6–10 percent regression and no production JobEffects currently reports multiple derivations. Fresh blocked-analysis counts show almost every blocked completion changes partial evidence, so the proposed preservation has little reusable work to recover. Retaining engine-wide derivation identity without a paying consumer contradicts the epic's simplification and work-reduction goals.

fz-tfn.21 owns deletion of DerivationId, JobDerivation and the dormant per-derivation scheduler substrate, with deterministic causal/allocation proof. Historical experiment branches and measurements are evidence only.
title: Refuted: per-answer derivations do not repay their cost
